name: smart-input
title: SmartInput
description: Text, voice or photo fills your zod form on device, with per-field confidence, deterministic refinement and confirm/undo.

files.content:
import { describeForPrompt, type FieldInfo } from '@ondai/core'

export function smartFormInstructions(fields: FieldInfo[], extra?: string): string {
  return [
    'Extract the fields from the user text and return JSON only.',
    `Fields: ${describeForPrompt(fields)}.`,
    'Leave a field out if the text does not mention it. Never invent values. Copy numbers and names exactly as written.',
    extra,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' ')
}

export { SmartInput, type SmartInputProps } from './smart-input'
export { useSmartForm, type SmartFormState, type UseSmartFormOptions } from './use-smart-form'
export { smartFormInstructions } from './prompts'

budget.strategy: One structured call; enum/number/date fields are refined deterministically after parsing.
